title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 12 (Chehalis Forest Service Road)
heading: Chehalis Forest Service Road
sourceText:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Chehalis Forest Service Road
12 That portion of M.U. 2-19 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of Chehalis Forest Service Road from the junction with the Statlu Forest Service Road to the northern boundary of the area described in section 33 of Schedule 5. [am. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 8.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

quotes.geometry.from: from the junction with the Statlu Forest Service Road
quotes.geometry.to: to the northern boundary of the area described in section 33 of Schedule 5

why: effect read from the text (no_shooting) differs from the schedule's effect (no_shooting_hunting_exempt)
none of the places the section names was found in the official layers
validation failed: shape built (no shape could be built)
